verses.text: Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘I na di Lord una God.
Una no go do like di doings of di land of Egypt, wia una dwell. Una no go do like di doings of di land of Canaan, wia I dey bring una. Una no go waka for dem statutes.
Una go do my ordinances, and keep my statutes, to waka for dem. I na di Lord una God.
Una go therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances. If one man do dem, e go live by dem. I na di Lord.
None of una go approach any wey be near of kin to am, to uncover nakedness. I na di Lord.
Di nakedness of your papa, or di nakedness of your mama, you no go uncover. Na your mama. You no go uncover im nakedness.
Di nakedness of your papa wife you no go uncover. E na your papa nakedness.
Di nakedness of your sister, di pikin woman of your papa, or di pikin woman of your mama, whether born for house or born abroad, even dem nakedness you no go uncover.
Di nakedness of your grandpikin, di pikin woman of your pikin man, or di pikin woman of your pikin woman, even dem nakedness you no go uncover, because dem na your own nakedness.
Di nakedness of di pikin woman of your papa wife, wey born to your papa, e na your sister. You no go uncover im nakedness.
You no go uncover di nakedness of your papa sister. E na your papa near relation.
You no go uncover di nakedness of your mama sister, because e na your mama near relation.
Di nakedness of your papa brother you no go uncover. You no go approach im wife. E na your aunt.
You no go uncover di nakedness of your pikin wife. E na your pikin wife. You no go uncover im nakedness.
You no go uncover di nakedness of your brother wife. E na your brother nakedness.

You no go uncover di nakedness of one woman and di woman pikin woman. You no go take di grandpikin woman of di woman, whether from im pikin man or from im pikin woman, to uncover im nakedness. Dem na near relations. E na wickedness.
You no go take one woman to im sister, to be rival, to uncover im nakedness, while im sister dey alive.
You no go approach one woman to uncover im nakedness, as long as e dey unclean by im impurity.
You no go lie carnally with your neighbour wife, to defile yourself with am.
You no go give any of your seed to pass through di fire to Molech, neither go you profane di name of your God. I na di Lord.
You no go lie with man as with woman. E na abomination.
You no go lie with any animal to defile yourself with am, neither go any woman stand before one animal to lie down to am. E na perversion.
Una no go defile yourselves for any of dem things, because for all dem things di nations wey I dey cast out before una don defile demself.
Di land dey defiled. Therefore I visit im iniquity on am, and di land vomit out im inhabitants.
Una go therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, and una no go do any of dem abominations, neither di native, nor di stranger wey dey dwell among una,
because all dem abominations di men of di land wey dey before una don do, and di land don dey defiled,
so that di land no go vomit una out also, when una defile am, as e vomit out di nation wey dey before una.
For whoever go do any of dem abominations, even di souls wey do dem go dey cut off from among dem people.
Therefore una go keep my commandment, so that una no go practice any of dem abominable customs, wey dem practice before una, and so that una no go defile yourselves for dem. I na di Lord una God.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to all di congregation of di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘Una go dey holy, because I, di Lord una God, dey holy.
Every one of una go respect im mama and im papa, and una go keep my Sabbaths. I na di Lord una God.
Una no go turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I na di Lord una God.
When una offer one sacrifice of peace offerings to di Lord, una go offer am so that una go dey accepted.
E go dey eaten di same day wey una offer am, and di next day. If anything remain until di third day, e go dey burnt with fire.
If e dey eaten at all on di third day, e na abomination. E no go dey accepted.
Everyone wey eat am go bear im iniquity, because e don profane di holy thing of di Lord. Dat soul go dey cut off from im people.
When una reap di harvest of una land, una no go reap to di corners of una field, neither go una gather di gleanings of una harvest.
Una no go glean una vineyard, neither go una gather di fallen fruit of una vineyard. Una go leave dem for di poor and for di stranger. I na di Lord una God.
Una no go steal. Una no go deal falsely. Una no go lie to one another.
Una no go swear by my name falsely, and profane di name of your God. I na di Lord.
You no go oppress your neighbour, nor rob am. Di wages of one hired servant no go stay with you all night until di morning.
You no go curse di deaf, nor put one stumbling block before di blind, but you go fear your God. I na di Lord.
Una no go do injustice for judgment. You no go respect di person of di poor, nor honour di person of di mighty. For righteousness you go judge your neighbour.
You no go go up and down as one slanderer among your people. You no go stand against di life of your neighbour. I na di Lord.
You no go hate your brother for your heart. You go surely rebuke your neighbour, and no bear sin because of am.
You no go take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against di pikin dem of your people, but you go love your neighbour as yourself. I na di Lord.
Una go keep my statutes. You no go let your livestock breed with one different kind. You no go sow your field with two kinds of seed. Neither go one garment mixed of linen and wool come on you.

Whoever lie carnally with one woman wey be one servant, wey dem don betroth to one man, and no ransom at all, nor freedom given to am, dem go dey punished. Dem no go dey put to death, because e no dey free.
E go bring im trespass offering to di Lord, to di door of di Tent of Meeting, even one ram for trespass offering.
Di priest go make atonement for am with di ram of di trespass offering before di Lord for im sin wey e don sin. Di sin wey e don sin go dey forgiven am.
When una come into di land, and don plant all kinds of trees for food, una go count di fruit of dem as uncircumcised. Three years e go dey as uncircumcised to una. E no go dey eaten.
But for di fourth year all dem fruit go be holy, for praise to di Lord.
For di fifth year una go eat of dem fruit, so that dem go yield more for una. I na di Lord una God.
Una no go eat anything with di blood. Una no go use enchantments nor practice sorcery.
Una no go round di corners of una heads, neither go you mar di corners of your beard.
Una no go make any cuts for una flesh for di dead, nor print any marks on yourselves. I na di Lord.
No profane your pikin woman, to make am one prostitute, so that di land no go fall to prostitution, and di land become full of wickedness.
Una go keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary. I na di Lord.
Una no go turn to dem wey get familiar spirits, nor to wizards. Una no go seek dem out to dey defiled by dem. I na di Lord una God.
Una go rise up before di grey head, and honour di face of di old man, and fear your God. I na di Lord.
If one stranger dey with you for una land, una no go do am wrong.
Di stranger wey dey with una go be to una as di native among una, and you go love am as yourself, because una dey strangers for di land of Egypt. I na di Lord una God.
Una no go do injustice for judgment, for measures of length, weight, or quantity.
Una go get just balances, just weights, one just ephah, and one just hin. I na di Lord una God, wey bring una out of di land of Egypt.
Una go observe all my statutes, and all my ordinances, and do dem. I na di Lord.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,

“Moreover, you go tell di pikin dem of Israel, ‘Anyone of di pikin dem of Israel, or of di strangers wey dey sojourn for Israel, wey give any of im seed to Molech, go surely dey put to death. Di people of di land go stone am with stones.
I go set my face against dat man, and go cut am off from among im people, because e don give some of im seed to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
If di people of di land at all hide dem eyes from dat man, when e give of im seed to Molech, and no kill am,
I go set my face against dat man, and against im family, and go cut am off, and all wey prostitute demself after am, to play di prostitute after Molech, from among dem people.
Di soul wey turn to dem wey get familiar spirits, and to wizards, to play di prostitute after dem, I go set my face against dat soul, and go cut am off from among im people.
Una go make yourselves holy therefore, and una go dey holy, because I na di Lord una God.
Una go keep my statutes, and do dem. I na di Lord wey make una holy.
Everyone wey curse im papa or im mama go surely dey put to death. E don curse im papa or im mama. Im blood go dey on am.
Di man wey commit adultery with one woman, even im wey commit adultery with im neighbour wife, di adulterer and di adulteress go surely dey put to death.
Di man wey lie with im papa wife don uncover im papa nakedness. Dem two go surely dey put to death. Dem blood go dey on dem.
If one man lie with im pikin wife, dem two go surely dey put to death. Dem don commit perversion. Dem blood go dey on dem.
If one man lie with man as with woman, dem two don commit abomination. Dem go surely dey put to death. Dem blood go dey on dem.
If one man take one woman and di woman mama, e na wickedness. Dem go burn am and dem with fire, so that no wickedness go dey among una.
If one man lie with one animal, e go surely dey put to death, and una go kill di animal.
If one woman approach any animal, and lie down to am, you go kill di woman, and di animal. Dem go surely dey put to death. Dem blood go dey on dem.

If one man take im sister, im papa pikin woman, or im mama pikin woman, and see im nakedness, and di woman see im nakedness, e na one shameful thing. Dem go dey cut off for di sight of di pikin dem of dem people. E don uncover im sister nakedness. E go bear im iniquity.

If one man lie with one woman wey dey for im period, and uncover im nakedness, e don make bare di woman fountain, and di woman don uncover di fountain of im blood. Dem two go dey cut off from among dem people.
You no go uncover di nakedness of your mama sister, nor of your papa sister, because e don make bare im near kin. Dem go bear dem iniquity.
If one man lie with im uncle wife, e don uncover im uncle nakedness. Dem go bear dem sin. Dem go die without pikin.
If one man take im brother wife, e na uncleanness. E don uncover im brother nakedness. Dem go dey without pikin.
Una go therefore keep all my statutes, and all my ordinances, and do dem, so that di land, wia I dey bring una to dwell, no go vomit una out.
Una no go waka for di customs of di nation wey I dey cast out before una, because dem do all dem things, and na why I abhor dem.
But I don talk to una say una go inherit dem land, and say I go give am to una to possess am, one land wey dey flow with milk and honey. I na di Lord una God, wey don separate una from di peoples.

Una go therefore make difference between di clean animal and di unclean, and between di unclean bird and di clean. Una no go make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything wey creep on di ground, wey I don set apart from una as unclean.
Una go dey holy to me, because I, di Lord, dey holy, and I don set una apart from di peoples, so that una go be mine.
Man or woman wey get familiar spirit or be wizard go surely dey put to death. Dem go stone dem with stones. Dem blood go dey on dem.’”
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Speak to di priests, di pikin man dem of Aaron, and tell dem, ‘No one go make imself unclean for di dead among im people,
except for im relatives wey dey near to am, dat na im mama, and im papa, and im pikin man, and im pikin woman, and im brother,
and for im sister wey be virgin, wey dey near to am, wey no get husband, for di sister e fit make imself unclean.
E no go make imself unclean as one husband among im people, to profane imself.
Dem no go make baldness upon dem heads, neither go dem shave off di corners of dem beards, nor make any cuts for dem flesh.
Dem go dey holy to dem God, and no profane di name of dem God, because dem offer di offerings of di Lord made by fire, di bread of dem God. Therefore dem go dey holy.
Dem no go take one woman wey be prostitute, or wey dey profane. Neither go dem take one woman wey im husband don divorce, because di priest dey holy to im God.
You go make am holy therefore, because e offer di bread of your God. E go dey holy to you, because I, di Lord wey make una holy, dey holy.
Di pikin woman of any priest, if di pikin woman profane imself by playing di prostitute, e profane im papa. Dem go burn di pikin woman with fire.
Im wey be di high priest among im brothers, on whose head di anointing oil dey poured, and wey dem don set apart to put on di garments, no go uncover im head, nor tear im clothes.
E no go go in to any dead body, nor make imself unclean for im papa or for im mama.
E no go go out of di sanctuary, nor profane di sanctuary of im God, because di setting apart by di anointing oil of im God dey on am. I na di Lord.
E go take one wife for im virginity.
One widow, or one divorced woman, or one wey dey profane, or one prostitute, dem na dem e no go take. But e go take one virgin of im own people as wife.
E no go profane im seed among im people, because I na di Lord wey make am holy.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to Aaron, talk, ‘Whoever of your seed throughout dem generations get any blemish, make e no come near to offer di bread of im God.
Because whoever get one blemish no go come near: one blind man, or one lame, or one wey get flat nose, or any deformed limb,
or one wey get broken foot, or broken hand,
or hunchbacked, or dwarf, or one wey get blemish for im eye, or eczema, or scabs, or one wey im testicles dey damaged.
No man of di seed of Aaron di priest wey get one blemish go come near to offer di offerings of di Lord made by fire. E get one blemish. E no go come near to offer di bread of im God.
E go eat di bread of im God, of di most holy, and of di holy.
Only e no go go in to di veil, nor come near to di altar, because e get one blemish, so that e no go profane my sanctuaries, because I na di Lord wey make dem holy.’”
So Moses speak to Aaron, and to im pikin man dem, and to all di pikin dem of Israel.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to Aaron and to im pikin man dem, say make dem deal carefully with di holy things of di pikin dem of Israel, wey dem make holy to me, and make dem no profane my holy name. I na di Lord.

Tell dem, ‘Whoever of all your seed throughout una generations go near to di holy things, wey di pikin dem of Israel make holy to di Lord, having im uncleanness upon am, dat soul go dey cut off from before me. I na di Lord.
Whoever of di seed of Aaron be leper, or get one discharge, no go eat of di holy things until e dey clean. Whoever touch anything wey dey unclean by di dead, or one man whose semen go out,
or whoever touch any creeping thing, by wey e go dey made unclean, or one man by wey e go dey made unclean, whatever uncleanness e get,
di soul wey touch any such go dey unclean until evening, and no go eat of di holy things, unless e bathe im flesh in water.
When di sun don go down, e go dey clean. After dat e go eat of di holy things, because na im food.
E no go eat wetin die of itself, or wetin dem tear by animals, to defile imself by am. I na di Lord.
Dem go therefore keep my ordinance, so that dem no go bear sin for am, and die for am, if dem profane am. I na di Lord wey make dem holy.
No stranger go eat of di holy thing. One sojourner of di priest, or one hired servant, no go eat of di holy thing.
But if di priest buy any soul with im money, e go eat of am, and dem wey dey born for im house go eat of im food.
If di priest pikin woman dey married to one stranger, e no go eat of di heave offering of di holy things.
But if di priest pikin woman dey one widow, or divorced, and get no pikin, and don return to im papa house, as for im youth, e go eat of im papa food. But no stranger go eat of am.
If one man eat of di holy thing by mistake, e go add di fifth part of di value to am, and go give di holy thing to di priest.
Dem no go profane di holy things of di pikin dem of Israel, wey dem offer to di Lord,
and so make dem bear di iniquity of guilt, when dem eat dem holy things, because I na di Lord wey make dem holy.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,

“Speak to Aaron, and to im pikin man dem, and to all di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘Whoever of di house of Israel, or of di strangers for Israel, wey offer im offering, whether na any of dem vows, or any of dem free will offerings, wey dem offer to di Lord for burnt offering,
make una offer so that una go dey accepted, one male without blemish, of di cattle, of di sheep, or of di goats.
But whatever get one blemish, una no go offer, because e no go dey accepted for una.
Whoever offer one sacrifice of peace offerings to di Lord to accomplish one vow, or for one free will offering, of di herd or of di flock, e go dey perfect to dey accepted. E go get no blemish.
Blind, or broken, or maimed, or one wey get one running sore, or eczema, or scabs, una no go offer dem to di Lord, nor make offering by fire of dem on di altar to di Lord.
Either one ox or one lamb wey get any part too long or too short, una fit offer for one free will offering, but for one vow e no go dey accepted.
Wetin dey bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut, una no go offer to di Lord. Neither go una do am for una land.
Neither from di hand of one foreigner una go offer di bread of una God of any of dem, because dem corruption dey for dem. Blemish dey for dem. Dem no go dey accepted for una.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“When one bull, or one sheep, or one goat dey born, e go dey seven days under im mama. From di eighth day and after, e go dey accepted for one offering made by fire to di Lord.
Whether na cow or ewe, una no go kill am and im young both for one day.
When una sacrifice one sacrifice of thanksgiving to di Lord, una go offer am so that una go dey accepted.
E go dey eaten for di same day. Una no go leave any of am until morning. I na di Lord.
Therefore una go keep my commandments, and do dem. I na di Lord.
Una no go profane my holy name, but I go dey made holy among di pikin dem of Israel. I na di Lord wey make una holy,
wey bring una out of di land of Egypt, to be una God. I na di Lord.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘Di Lord feasts, wey una go proclaim to dey holy convocations, even dem na my feasts.
Six days work go dey done, but di seventh day na Sabbath of solemn rest, one holy convocation. Una go do no kind of work. E na Sabbath to di Lord for all una dwellings.
Dem na di feasts of di Lord, even holy convocations, wey una go proclaim for dem appointed times.
For di first month, on di 14th day of di month, between di two evenings, na di Lord Passover.
On di 15th day of di same month na di feast of unleavened bread to di Lord. Seven days una go eat unleavened bread.
For di first day una go get one holy convocation. Una go do no regular work.
But una go offer one offering made by fire to di Lord seven days. For di seventh day na holy convocation. Una go do no regular work.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘When una don come into di land wey I give una, and don reap di harvest of am, una go bring di sheaf of di firstfruits of una harvest to di priest.
E go wave di sheaf before di Lord, to dey accepted for una. On di next day after di Sabbath di priest go wave am.
For di day wey una wave di sheaf, una go offer one male lamb without blemish of di first year for one burnt offering to di Lord.
Im meal offering go be two tenths of one ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, one offering made by fire to di Lord for pleasing aroma. Im drink offering go be of wine, one fourth of one hin.
Una no go eat bread, nor roasted grain, nor fresh grain, until di same day wey una don bring di offering of una God. E go be one statute forever throughout una generations for all una dwellings.
Una go count for yourselves from di next day after di Sabbath, from di day wey una bring di sheaf of di wave offering. Seven Sabbaths go dey completed.
Even to di next day after di seventh Sabbath una go count 50 days. Una go offer one new meal offering to di Lord.
Una go bring from una dwellings two loaves of bread for wave offering, made of two tenths of one ephah. Dem go be of fine flour, dem go dey baked with leaven, as firstfruits to di Lord.

Una go present with di bread seven lambs without blemish of di first year, and one young bull, and two rams. Dem go be one burnt offering to di Lord, with dem meal offering, and dem drink offerings, even one offering made by fire, of pleasing aroma to di Lord.
Una go offer one male goat for sin offering, and two male lambs of di first year for one sacrifice of peace offerings.
Di priest go wave dem with di bread of di firstfruits for wave offering before di Lord, with di two lambs. Dem go be holy to di Lord for di priest.
Una go make proclamation on di same day. E go be one holy convocation to una. Una go do no regular work. E na one statute forever for all una dwellings throughout una generations.

When una reap di harvest of una land, una no go reap to di corners of una field, neither go una gather di gleanings of una harvest. Una go leave dem for di poor and for di stranger. I na di Lord una God.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, ‘For di seventh month, on di first day of di month, una go get one solemn rest, one memorial of blowing of trumpets, one holy convocation.
Una go do no regular work. Una go offer one offering made by fire to di Lord.’”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“On di tenth day of dis seventh month na di Day of Atonement. E go be one holy convocation to una, and una go afflict una souls. Una go offer one offering made by fire to di Lord.
Una go do no kind of work for dat same day, because e na Day of Atonement, to make atonement for una before di Lord una God.
Because whoever e be wey no afflict im soul for dat same day, e go dey cut off from im people.
Whoever do any kind of work for dat same day, dat soul I go destroy from among im people.
Una go do no kind of work. E na one statute forever throughout una generations for all una dwellings.
E go be to una one Sabbath of solemn rest, and una go afflict una souls. For di ninth day of di month for evening, from evening to evening, una go keep una Sabbath.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, ‘On di 15th day of dis seventh month na di feast of booths for seven days to di Lord.
On di first day go be one holy convocation. Una go do no regular work.

Seven days una go offer offerings made by fire to di Lord. On di eighth day go be one holy convocation to una. Una go offer one offering made by fire to di Lord. E na one solemn assembly. Una go do no regular work.

Dem na di feasts of di Lord, wey una go proclaim to dey holy convocations, to offer offerings made by fire to di Lord, burnt offerings, meal offerings, sacrifices, and drink offerings, each on im own day,
besides di Sabbaths of di Lord, and besides una gifts, and besides all una vows, and besides all una free will offerings, wey una give to di Lord.

Also on di 15th day of di seventh month, when una don gather in di fruits of di land, una go keep di feast of di Lord seven days. On di first day go be one solemn rest, and on di eighth day go be one solemn rest.

Una go take for yourselves for di first day di fruit of di majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of leafy trees, and willows of di brook. Una go rejoice before di Lord una God seven days.
Una go keep am as one feast to di Lord seven days for di year. E go be one statute forever throughout una generations. Una go keep am for di seventh month.
Una go dwell for booths seven days. All wey dey native born for Israel go dwell for booths,
so that una generations go know say I make di pikin dem of Israel dwell for booths, when I bring dem out of di land of Egypt. I na di Lord una God.’”
Moses declare to di pikin dem of Israel di feasts of di Lord.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Command di pikin dem of Israel, say make dem bring to you pure olive oil beaten for di light, to cause one lamp to burn continually.
Outside di veil of di testimony, for di Tent of Meeting, Aaron go keep am in order from evening to morning before di Lord continually. E go be one statute forever throughout una generations.
E go keep in order di lamps on di pure gold lampstand before di Lord continually.
You go take fine flour, and bake 12 cakes of am. Two tenths of one ephah go dey in one cake.
You go set dem for two rows, six for one row, on di pure gold table before di Lord.
You go put pure frankincense on each row, so that e go be for di bread for memorial, even one offering made by fire to di Lord.
Every Sabbath day e go set am in order before di Lord continually. E na from di pikin dem of Israel, one everlasting covenant.
E go be Aaron own and im pikin man dem own. Dem go eat am for one holy place, because e dey most holy to am of di offerings of di Lord made by fire, by one perpetual statute.”
Di pikin man of one Israelite woman, whose papa na one Egyptian, go out among di pikin dem of Israel. Di pikin man of di Israelite woman and one man of Israel strive together for di camp.
Di pikin man of di Israelite woman blaspheme di Name, and curse. Dem bring am to Moses. Im mama name na Shelomith, di pikin woman of Dibri, of di tribe of Dan.
Dem put am for custody, so that di mind of di Lord go dey declared to dem.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Bring out of di camp am wey don curse. Make all wey hear am lay dem hands on im head, and make all di congregation stone am.
You go speak to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, ‘Whoever curse im God go bear im sin.
Im wey blaspheme di name of di Lord go surely dey put to death. All di congregation go surely stone am. Di stranger as di native born, when e blaspheme di Name, go dey put to death.
Im wey kill any man go surely dey put to death.
Im wey kill one animal go make am good, life for life.
If anyone injure im neighbour, as e don do, so e go dey done to am:
fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. As e don injure anyone, so e go dey injured.
Im wey kill one animal go make restitution for am. Im wey kill one man go dey put to death.
Una go get one law for di stranger and di native, because I na di Lord una God.’”
Moses speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and dem bring out of di camp am wey don curse, and stone am with stones. Di pikin dem of Israel do as di Lord command Moses.
Di Lord speak to Moses for Mount Sinai, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘When una come into di land wey I give una, di land go keep one Sabbath to di Lord.
Six years una go sow una field, and six years una go prune una vineyard, and gather im fruits,
but for di seventh year go be one Sabbath of solemn rest for di land, one Sabbath to di Lord. Una no go sow una field, nor prune una vineyard.
Wetin grow of itself from una harvest una no go reap, and di grapes of una undressed vine una no go gather. E go be one year of solemn rest for di land.
Di Sabbath of di land go provide food for una: for you, and for your male servant, and for your female servant, and for your hired servant, and for your stranger wey dey sojourn with you,
and for your livestock, and for di animals wey dey una land. All im increase go be food.
Una go count seven Sabbaths of years for yourselves, seven times seven years, and di time of di seven Sabbaths of years go be to una 49 years.
Una go sound di loud trumpet for di seventh month, for di tenth day of di month. For di Day of Atonement una go sound di trumpet throughout all una land.

Una go make di 50th year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout di land to all im inhabitants. E go be one jubilee to una. Una go return every man to im possession, and una go return every man to im family.
Di 50th year go be one jubilee to una. Una no go sow, nor reap wetin grow of itself, nor gather di grapes of una undressed vines.
Because na jubilee. E go be holy to una. Una go eat di increase of am out of di field.
For dis year of jubilee una go return every man to im possession.
If una sell anything to una neighbour, or buy from una neighbour, una no go wrong one another.
According to di number of years after di jubilee, una go buy from una neighbour. According to di number of years of di crops, e go sell to una.
According to di multitude of di years, una go increase im price, and according to di fewness of di years, una go diminish im price, because na di number of di crops wey e dey sell to una.
Una no go wrong one another, but una go fear una God, because I na di Lord una God.
Therefore una go do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do dem. Una go dwell for di land in safety.
Di land go yield im fruit, and una go eat until una dey full, and dwell dere in safety.
If una go ask wetin una go eat for di seventh year, since una no go sow, nor gather in una increase,
I go command my blessing on una for di sixth year, and e go bring forth fruit for three years.
Una go sow for di eighth year, and eat of di fruit, old store. Until di ninth year, until im fruit come in, una go eat di old store.
Di land no go dey sold in perpetuity, because di land na mine, because una na strangers and sojourners with me.
For all di land of una possession una go grant one redemption for di land.
If one of your brothers dey poor, and sell some of im possession, im near relative go come and redeem wetin im brother don sell.
If di man get nobody to redeem am, and e don prosper and get enough to redeem am,
make am count di years since im sale, and restore di balance to di man to whom e sell am, and return to im possession.
But if e no fit get enough to restore am to imself, wetin e sell go remain for di hand of im wey don buy am until di year of jubilee. For di jubilee e go go out, and e go return to im possession.
If one man sell one dwelling house for one walled city, im right of redemption go last until one whole year after im sale. For one full year e go get di right of redemption.
If e no dey redeemed within di space of one full year, di house wey dey for di walled city go dey established forever to am wey buy am, throughout im generations. E no go go out for di jubilee.
But di houses of di villages wey no get wall round dem go dey counted as di fields of di country. Dem go get redemption, and dem go go out for di jubilee.
Nevertheless di cities of di Levites, di houses of di cities of dem possession, di Levites fit redeem at any time.

If one man buy from di Levites, di house wey e sell, for di city of im possession, go go out for di jubilee, because di houses of di cities of di Levites na dem possession among di pikin dem of Israel.
But di fields of di pasture lands of dem cities no go dey sold, because na dem perpetual possession.
If one of your brothers dey poor, and im hand fail among una, una go uphold am. Una go support am as one stranger and one sojourner, so that e go live with una.
Take no interest from am, or profit, but fear your God, so that your brother go live with you.
You no go lend am your money at interest, nor give am your food for profit.
I na di Lord una God, wey bring una out of di land of Egypt, to give una di land of Canaan, and to be una God.
If one of your brothers dey poor among una, and sell imself to you, you no go make am serve as one slave.
E go be with you as one hired servant, and as one sojourner. E go serve with you until di year of jubilee.
E go go out from you, e and im pikin dem with am, and e go return to im own family, and to di possession of im papa dem e go return.
Because dem na my servants, wey I bring out of di land of Egypt. Dem no go dey sold as slaves.
You no go rule over am with rigor, but you go fear your God.
As for your male and female slaves, wey una go get, una go buy male and female slaves from di nations wey dey round una.
Moreover of di pikin dem of di strangers wey dey sojourn among una, una fit buy from dem, and from dem families wey dey with una, wey dem born for una land. Dem go be una possession.

Una go make dem inheritance for una pikin dem after una, to hold as possession. Una fit make dem slaves forever. But over una brothers, di pikin dem of Israel, una no go rule, one over another, with rigor.
If one stranger or sojourner with you get rich, and one of your brothers wey dey near am dey poor, and sell imself to di stranger or sojourner with you, or to di offspring of di stranger family,
after e don sell imself, e fit dey redeemed. One of im brothers fit redeem am.
Im uncle, or im uncle pikin, fit redeem am, or any wey dey near of kin to am of im family fit redeem am. Or if e don prosper, e fit redeem imself.

E go reckon with im wey buy am from di year wey e sell imself to am until di year of jubilee. Di price of im sale go dey according to di number of years. E go dey with am according to di time of one hired servant.
If dere still dey many years, e go pay for im redemption, according to dem, out of di money wey dem buy am with.
If dere remain but few years until di year of jubilee, e go reckon with am. According to im years e go pay for im redemption.
E go dey with am as one servant hired year by year. E no go rule over am with rigor for your sight.
If e no dey redeemed by any of dem means, e go go out for di year of jubilee, e and im pikin dem with am.
Because to me di pikin dem of Israel na servants. Dem na my servants wey I bring out of di land of Egypt. I na di Lord una God.’”
